name: ContextSwitcherPanel
description: The switcher's list, always open, for a sheet, a page or the gallery.
signature: <I extends ContextItem>({ items, remote, value, onValueChange, recent, labels: labelsProp, all, icon, }: ContextSwitcherPanelProps<I>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: icon
props.description: The glyph for the "all" scope (default the organisation glyph).

props.name: items
props.description: Complete local hierarchy, or the loaded flat server results when remote is supplied.

props.name: labels
props.description: The words it shows and announces; see ContextSwitcher's `labels`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen context id, or null for all, when the person picks a row (also when it is the current one).

props.name: recent
props.description: Previously selected ids, ordered most recent first.

props.name: remote
props.description: Controlled server search and paging; parent links and local recents are ignored.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected context id, or null for the "all" scope (or none, when `all` is false).
